intro: ILR means you can live, work and study in the UK without time limits. Most people qualify after a set period on a spouse, Skilled Worker or other route. Settlement rules are changing, so we check exactly where you stand before you apply.
title: Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) Applications | UVS
description: Apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain with an IAA-regulated adviser. We check your residence, Life in the UK and English requirements first.

faqs.q: How long do I need to have lived in the UK?
faqs.a: It depends on your visa route, and the government has been changing settlement rules. We confirm your qualifying date at your consultation.

faqs.q: Does time abroad affect my application?
faqs.a: Yes. Too many days outside the UK can break continuous residence. We check your travel history before you apply.
